question: The Wazir (minister) of ________ built Moth ki Masjid in Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikandar Lodi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Moth ki Masjid, also known as the "Lentil Mosque," was built during the reign of Sikandar Lodi in the early 16th century.
 
• Sikandar Lodi was the Sultan of Delhi from 1489 to 1517.
 
• The mosque is located in the South Extension part of Delhi.
 
• The name "Moth ki Masjid" is derived from a story that a minister of Sikandar Lodi used a lentil (moth) as a symbol to finance the construction of the mosque.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alauddin Khalji**

 
 
• Alauddin Khalji was the second ruler of the Khalji dynasty in India, ruling from 1296 to 1316.
 
• He is known for his military conquests and administrative reforms.
 
• He did not build the Moth ki Masjid.
 
 
 
• **Khizr Khan**
 
 
• Khizr Khan was the founder of the Sayyid dynasty in Delhi, ruling from 1414 to 1421.
 
• He was a former governor under the Tughlaq dynasty.
 
• He did not build the Moth ki Masjid.
 
 
 
• **Firuz Shah Tughluq**
 
 
• Firuz Shah Tughluq was the Sultan of Delhi from 1351 to 1388.
 
• He was known for his infrastructural projects, including canals, mosques, and public buildings.
 
• He did not build the Moth ki Masjid.
